search_audit.outcome: Search results surfaced the exact 校 Commons page, official Ministry dictionary, and Academia Sinica Xiaoxuetang. Inspected the Commons file page and original-image link, the Ministry entry, Xiaoxuetang query landing page, and Academia Sinica database description. Search did not establish an independently dated early inscription image for 校.

search_audit.query: Unicode character-specific Unihan records U+4EA4 交 and U+6821 校
search_audit.outcome: Attempted both official character-specific pages; both returned browser internal errors. Exact local rows supplied with the input are recorded as local data, not external-page verification.

gaps: No dated oracle-bone, bronze, or other independently dated early inscription for 校 was verified. The selected Commons file is a modern Shuowen seal-style redraw, not an artifact image.
The Xiaoxuetang query landing page did not expose character-specific glyph records in inspectable text, so no Xiaoxuetang candidate or image was selected.
The local Unihan rows give current readings 交 jiāo and 校 xiào; official character-specific Unicode pages were inaccessible. Current readings do not verify a historical sound relation.

The local Baxter–Sagart row gives 交 MC kaew and OC *[k]ˤraw, but no 校 row was present. Thus comparable same-system reconstructions are unavailable here. Shuowen and the Ministry dictionary assert 交's phonetic role; independent reconstruction-level confirmation is not established.

Dictionary citations attest restraint, barrier, military organization, checking, and school uses, but their first dates and semantic sequence remain unresolved. In particular, the school use in the transmitted 孟子 does not establish a transition from restraint or barrier.

The Shuowen wooden-restraint gloss does not independently establish the physical object's original name or pronunciation and does not establish whole-graph borrowing. This remains separate from the asserted internal phonetic role of 交.
